title: GenAI evaluation logged-model metrics: pass the explicit managed EvaluationDataset into aggregate metric logging so dataset_name and dataset_digest are recorded
answers: Why do logged model metrics from mlflow.genai.evaluate with model_id show null dataset_name and dataset_digest?
How do I make aggregate scorer metrics on a logged model record which evaluation dataset they came from?
Where is the dataset passed when GenAI evaluation logs aggregated metrics to a run or logged model?
Does evaluating with a plain list or DataFrame also attach a dataset to logged model metrics?
body:
Path: mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness builds the evaluation call for mlflow.genai.evaluate(data=..., predict_fn=..., scorers=..., model_id=...) and hands it to mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run, which computes aggregated scorer metrics (compute_aggregated_metrics) and logs them with mlflow.log_metrics.
Rule: _run_harness forwards the managed EvaluationDataset (mlflow_dataset) as `dataset=` into harness.run only when is_managed_dataset is true, otherwise None; harness.run accepts `dataset` and calls mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics, dataset=dataset). Any new path that logs aggregate GenAI metrics for an explicitly supplied managed dataset should thread the dataset the same way instead of logging bare metrics.
Symptom: After evaluating a managed dataset against a logged model, the model's aggregate metrics (e.g. `<scorer>/mean`) had dataset_name and dataset_digest set to null, so they could not be tied to the dataset they were computed on, while a manual mlflow.log_metrics(..., dataset=dataset) call recorded both.
Constraints: Applies only when the caller explicitly passes a managed evaluation dataset. Plain list/DataFrame inputs keep dataset=None and their logging behavior is unchanged. Per-row results are not affected by this change; only the aggregate metric logging call.
applies: Scope: GenAI evaluation (mlflow.genai.evaluate) aggregate metric logging for model_id runs with managed EvaluationDataset inputs.
says: Aggregate metrics on logged models show empty dataset names after running an evaluation.
Model evaluation summary metrics cannot be traced back to the evaluation dataset used.
Show the dataset name and digest on evaluation metrics logged to a model.
Model metric tables display null dataset identifiers for completed evaluation runs.
Link aggregate evaluation scores directly to the managed dataset in the model view.
search: When evaluating a logged model using `mlflow.genai.evaluate` with a managed `EvaluationDataset`, `mlflow.genai.evaluation.base:_run_harness` must forward the dataset into `harness.run` so `mlflow.log_metrics` records `dataset_name` and `dataset_digest`. Without passing the managed dataset parameter, aggregated model metrics such as mean scores had null `dataset_name` and `dataset_digest`, leaving metrics detached from their source dataset. This applies solely to aggregate metric logging for managed evaluation datasets; inputs provided as plain lists or DataFrames retain `dataset=None`. Per-row evaluation results remain unchanged by this metric logging rule.
